dogecoin.text: Dogecoin has an unlimited number of coins that will ever be made. Every minute 10,000 new Dogecoin’s are mined. Bitcoin has a cap of 21 million coins by the year 2140 so it’s highly limited. Dogecoin’s will always be cheap because there are so many of them.

Dogecoin produces a new block every minute and has very small transaction fees that are usually under 1 penny. This makes Dogecoin cheap and fast to use. Bitcoin’s transactions happen every 10 min and have higher fees (sometimes 10 USD).
Dogecoin may be proof of work but it uses script language which makes it a GPU mining coin instead of ASIIC mining. Bitcoin miners need separate computers to mine #Dogecoin
Dogecoin is lighthearted so no one takes it too seriously and this encourages the community to be more fun loving and generous with their coins. #DogeDay420
